CHAPTER.VERS: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm of David. May Yahweh answer you in the day of trouble; The name of the God of Jacob set you up on high;
Send you help from the sanctuary, And strengthen you out of Zion;
Remember all your offerings, And accept your burnt-sacrifice; Selah.
Grant you your heart's desire, And fulfill all your counsel.
We will triumph in your salvation, And in the name of our God we will set up our banners: Yahweh fulfill all your petitions.
Now I know that Yahweh saves his anointed; He will answer him from his holy heaven With the saving strength of his right hand.
Some [trust] in chariots, and some in horses; But we will make mention of the name of Yahweh our God.
They are bowed down and fallen; But we have risen, and stand upright.
Save, Yahweh: Let the King answer us when we call.
